## Goal
Prove TigerIQ continues operating through component failures.

## Acceptance matrix
- Core healthy -> NV02 works.
- Core stopped -> bounded grace -> NV02 still obtains safe work.
- Core restored -> authority returns without duplicate dispatch.
- NV02 continuity fault -> independent repair path activates.
- One API provider fails -> another healthy provider continues.
- Coding Lane unavailable -> independent recovery restarts/rolls back it.
- Job DONE -> next eligible job starts automatically.
- Owner private chat / 00 / 01 pauses only reserved scope.
- No Production / paid / credential-security / destructive / irreversible action.
- Every PASS/rollback/blocker has durable evidence.
AUTO_RELEASE_AFTER=#1349


## AUTO HANDOFF CHAIN — 2026-09-21
- This acceptance auto-releases only after #1349 closes completed.
- No Owner/Vy prompt is required between #1349 completion and #1339 execution.

[CHAOS_ACCEPTANCE_AUDIT][#1339] 2026-09-21

DEPENDENCY:
- #1338 = CLOSED/COMPLETED and auto-release into #1339 is durably recorded.
- #1339 was READY before this audit.

HISTORICAL/LIVE EVIDENCE ALREADY PROVEN:
1. Core healthy -> NV02 works = PASS.
   Evidence: #1333 live Core-selected GH-1333/NV02 dispatch; NV02 entered WORKING; terminal reconciliation completed with no duplicate dispatch.
2. Core stopped -> bounded grace -> NV02 still obtains safe work = PASS.
   Evidence: #1330 BOOTSTRAP_PASS canary: Core-down returned bounded grace then NV02 GitHub fallback at ~5.2s.
3. Core restored -> authority returns without duplicate dispatch = PASS.
   Evidence: #1330 canary returned source=CORE/authority=CORE immediately on recovery; #1334 restart reconciliation retained GH-1334/worker NV02 without second dispatch.
4. Job DONE -> next eligible job starts automatically = PASS.
   Evidence: #1338 closeout auto-released #1339 as NEXT_SAFE_FINITE_JOB.
5. Hard gates = PASS to date.
   No direct main, Production, paid, credential/security, destructive/irreversible, browser-auth or PC01-shell action used by this acceptance audit.

NV02 CONTINUITY FAULT:
- Independent repair path DID activate: live fault #1349 -> canonical source repair PR #1355 -> merged ce33c81e716bf8a8ed754455599df175fa0ae80a with exact-head workflows PASS.
- But live repair acceptance FAILED. #1349 remains STATE=BLOCKED / TIGERIQ_EXECUTABLE=false / BLOCKER=RUNTIME_OWNER_DEPLOY_CONFLICT.
- Durable live evidence on #1349: :8799 ECONNREFUSED; recovered :8798 was stale Canary1038-R2 with autopilot STOPPED and NV02 disabled; install failed NV02_PACKAGE_FAILED_AND_ROLLBACK_FAILED / HTTP_HEALTH_TIMEOUT :8799; runtime-owner mismatch between Start-Workspace-826.ps1 / NV02FollowWatch and Install-NV02-Continuity.
=> This row is NOT terminal PASS.

UNRESOLVED CHAOS ROWS — DO NOT FABRICATE PASS:
6. One API provider fails -> another healthy provider continues = NOT YET LIVE-PROVEN.
   #1336/PR #1346 proves source/tests and Coding Lane has provider-failover code on main, but the durable #1336 evidence does not identify an actual provider outage canary with another provider completing the same eligible work.
7. Coding Lane unavailable -> independent recovery restarts/rolls back it = NOT YET LIVE-PROVEN.
   #1335/PR #1353 merged with exact-head workflows PASS, but its patch adds bounded restart/health/preflight helpers; no durable #1335 comment proves a real Coding Lane fault injection followed by independent restart/rollback.
8. Owner private chat / 00 / 01 pauses only reserved scope = policy/source behavior exists, but this #1339 chaos run has not executed a fresh scoped-intervention canary.

HARD BLOCKER NOW:
- Current runtime baseline is already degraded by #1349. Running additional fault injection while the controller/Direct-CDP pair is not healthy would not prove 24/24 resilience and could compound the fault.
- #1339 has NO_PC01_SHELL=true, so this acceptance lane must not bypass #1349 by manually switching/restarting local runtime.

RESULT=BLOCKED
BLOCKER=#1349:RUNTIME_OWNER_DEPLOY_CONFLICT
CHAOS_ACCEPTANCE=BLOCKED_BEFORE_FURTHER_FAULT_INJECTION
NEXT_AFTER_BLOCKER=restore #1349 live baseline, then execute only unresolved rows: real provider failover, real Coding Lane unavailable recovery, scoped Owner intervention; attach durable evidence for each.
NO_DUPLICATE_REPAIR=true
